children: Base is still considering issuing a token but is not rushing to move forward, Jesse Pollak, the project’s lead, said in an interview on November 22.

According to Odaily, Base initially decided against issuing a token to avoid early token-market noise distracting from its search for product-market fit. As Base considers further decentralization, coordinating economic interests across its ecosystem and advancing blockchain innovation, a token could become an important tool.
Pollak said further decentralization should support Base’s existing business growth rather than divert the team’s attention. He added that the team still has substantial work to complete.

title: Jesse Pollak: Base Is Exploring a Token but Is in No Rush to Proceed
